summary: iptables options: protocol, reject_with (implies REJECT), rule_num for inserts, set_counters, and DSCP marking via set_dscp_mark or set_dscp_mark_class.
questions: How do I insert a rule at a specific position number?
How do I reject with tcp-reset instead of dropping?
How do I set DSCP marks on packets?
What's the default protocol for an iptables rule?

answer_card.title: iptables protocol, reject, DSCP
answer_card.answer_md:
- `protocol`: `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `all` (default), number, or `/etc/protocols` name; `!` inverts
- `reject_with`: e.g. `tcp-reset`; implies `jump=REJECT`
- `rule_num`: position, only with `action=insert`
- `set_dscp_mark` / `set_dscp_mark_class` (mutually exclusive; sets `jump=DSCP`)
- `set_counters`
